description: Blank second-vertical adapter template. This is a contract scaffold only: it contains no live evidence, no pilot result and no certified Signal.

disallowed_collection: circumventing login, captcha, paywall or robots restrictions
inventing ratings, review counts, menu prices or revenue impact

entity_identity_rules: TO_DEFINE: brand, address, official website and review profile must refer to the same restaurant entity.
TO_DEFINE: multiple locations or delivery-only profiles must be resolved before scoring.
TO_DEFINE: out-of-area or ambiguous review links block Signal promotion.
observable_customer_path_signals: TO_DEFINE: reservation path, menu visibility, hours, phone/WhatsApp and review trust route.
comparator_rules: TO_DEFINE: comparator must match target segment, price/occasion context and local decision market.
TO_DEFINE: comparator evidence must focus on decision path, not food quality claims.
red_team_falsification_prompts: TO_DEFINE: is reservation/contact already clear through another official channel?
TO_DEFINE: is the comparator truly same occasion/segment?
TO_DEFINE: are review signals current and entity-matched?
TO_DEFINE: is the finding only generic menu/site hygiene?

contact_script_framing.must_not_do: No food-quality claim, no revenue claim, no review-volume shaming.

signal_promotion_rules: Define gate checklist before any client-facing report.
Promote only after entity, review, customer path, comparator and Red Team evidence exist.
